{{Quote|Ratts Tyerell is in his tent. He is ready to challenge you to a Ratt's Race.|Z-P70|<ref name="SWM">''[[Star Wars Math: Jabba's Game Galaxy]]''</ref>}}
A '''tent''' was a portable shelter or lodge, usually made of cloth or skin, stretched and sustained by poles. They came in a great variety of shapes, from rougly conical to rectangular. Tents were primarily used as portable homes by nomadic people such as the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], whose shelters were known as [[Urtya/Legends|urtya]].<ref name="AOCV">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref>

Tents were also part of the [[Army/Legends|armies']] life. When permanent structures were not required or available, military camp often consisted of tents, some of which were communal while other were personal&mdash;usually the privilege of [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officers]]. Personal tents used by military leaders could be very spacious&mdash;some were large enough to be used as assembly halls for war councils&mdash;and very ornate.<ref name="JVS">''[[Star Wars: Jedi vs. Sith]]''</ref> According to [[Darth Bane/Legends|Darth Bane]], [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Qordis]]' tent on [[Korriban/Legends|Korriban]] had been decorated with rare woven tapestries and ornate [[Carpet/Legends|rugs]].<ref name="DBRT">''[[Darth Bane: Rule of Two]]''</ref>

[[File:CW_tents.png|thumb|left|Although primitive, tents were still used by modern armies.]]
By the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], some [[Jedi General/Legends|Jedi Generals]] still used tents as their temporary headquarters on the battlefront.<ref name="JY">''[[Jedi: Yoda]]''</ref><ref name="TTVP">{{CWACite|6|To the Vanishing Point}}</ref> When the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] explored the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]] of his [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Korun/Legends|Korun]], he used a "wallet tent" he kept in a hand-sized pocket of his kitbag. Once the pressure seal was pressed, the tent's internally articulated ribs automatically unfolded a transparent skin to make a shelter large enough for two persons.<ref name="SP">[[Shatterpoint (novel)|''Shatterpoint'']]</ref> Survival tents were available in several formats, which could accommodate from one to six persons and cost from 200 to 600 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standard]] at the time of the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="TSWS">''[[The Star Wars Sourcebook]]''</ref>

At the time of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], there also existed inflatable tents that could be used in case of emergency. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] kept one such tent aboard his personal ship, the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and he used it when he decided to explore the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]].<ref name="CPL">''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]''</ref>
